regions.today: Dry in most parts at first with a few bright or sunny spells. Outbreaks of rain and drizzle, already in the southwest, will extend to all parts through the afternoon and early evening. The rain will turn heavy in places. Some hill and coastal fog will develop in the south later. Highest temperatures of 11 to 15 degrees in light southerly breezes, backing southeasterly and increasing moderate to fresh. Strong winds will develop near the south coast this evening.
regions.tonight: Rain and drizzle, persistent at times, will clear northeastwards through the first half of tonight, with dry spells developing. However, showers or longer spells of rain will follow from the southwest and may turn heavy. Mild, with temperatures falling no lower than 8 to 11 degrees. Moderate to fresh southeast winds, strong at times near the coast, will veer south to southwest and decrease light to moderate away from the south coast.
regions.tomorrow: A few bright or sunny spells on Tuesday, but mostly cloudy with widespread showers, occasionally merging to longer spells of rain. The showers will be heavy at times, with the chance of a few isolated thunderstorms. Highest temperatures of 12 to 16 degrees in moderate, locally fresh and gusty, southwest winds, which will be stronger at times near the south coast.
regions.solar_uv: Low to moderate on Monday and Tuesday.
